title: Fellow Marine refuses to come forward (text messages)

tellings.quote: My family and military career far exceed anything you are asking of me.

plain: A fellow Marine who could back up Michael Herrera's story turned him down by text message, writing, "My family and military career far exceed anything you are asking of me." Herrera is a former Marine who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle. Michels reads the texts himself on the episode with Herrera, as a sign of how hard it is to get other witnesses to speak.
